At 55b3cbb, F259a moves the debt answer to the QUEUE being drained. SqliteQueue owes via two covering jobs_claimable range arms; prefix bounds are delivery; and delivery-control;. Each arm loops pending/running, so two EXPLAIN SEARCH nodes mean FOUR underlying state/prefix seeks. Queue SQL sorts both arms and UNION-merges/dedupes; registry JSON DISTINCT plus named PK seeks/ORDER remains. Row visits L+open delivery rows J+owed D excludes unrelated jobs and unowed history, but sorting, seek heights, decoding and allocations remain.

The split adds PRAGMA+SELECT: roster prep 4 application statements instead of 2; unchanged nonempty-kind peek adds 2 (6 total before dispatch), plus pool/worker overhead. No new write, launch or loop; configurable default5s plus existing deadline wakes, not hard0.2Hz. FakeQueue scans all live/claimed kinds under mutex; default Registry retains full read + Vec membership (N x D worst case); None falls back to full roster. Do not generalize SQLite's bound to these paths.
